retrievalProfile.description: A high-key beach portrait featuring two male subjects in casual attire with large, distressed display typography and a central graphic symbol overlay.
excludeWhen: dark or moody lighting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, overexposed beach scene featuring two men standing on a concrete curb, framed by large, textured sans-serif typography at the top and a smaller subtitle at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects positioned centrally against a washed-out, high-key background
Large display text anchored to the top edge, overlapping a central graphic
Diagonal line of the concrete curb creating depth and leading the eye
Contrast between dark clothing/text and the bright, sandy environment
coreInvariants: Distressed, weathered texture applied to the primary display typography
High-key exposure that bleeds the horizon into the sky
Central graphic element acting as a bridge between two words

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-body subjects in the middle ground, scaled to occupy the vertical center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, dark display text at the top of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top display text, moves down to the subjects, follows the curb line, and ends at the bottom subtitle.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive high-key negative space in the background (sand and sky) to emphasize the subjects and text.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value, low saturation background contrasted with low value, high contrast foreground elements.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant or warm colors in the background

letterConstructionRules: Heavy distressing and erosion texture within the letterforms
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature irregular, chipped edges to simulate weathered paint
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Condensed distressed display paired with a clean, widely-tracked condensed sans-serif for metadata.
graphicDevices: Large central plus-sign graphic with a painterly, semi-transparent texture

avoid: Clean, modern geometric fonts for the display role

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the condensed, bold skeleton of the display text.
Provides the built-in distressed, letterpress look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key, overexposed beach scene with two men in casual dark clothing standing on a concrete curb. The background should be a bright, washed-out sandy landscape where the horizon line is barely visible.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed, distressed navy blue uppercase text at the top, centered. Place a semi-transparent light blue textured plus sign behind the center of the text. Add a smaller, clean condensed navy blue subtitle at the bottom with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the background sufficiently high-key and washed out?
Does the top text have a visible weathered/distressed texture?
Is the plus sign graphic centered and layered correctly?
Is the bottom text widely tracked and clean?

adjustableVariables: Level of distressing on the typography
Opacity of the central graphic symbol
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Exact brand logos or trademarked symbols

avoid: Muddy or dark shadows in the background
Generic, clean digital fonts without texture for the display role

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text is legible despite distressing
Verify the subjects are in sharp focus relative to the background
Check that the blue accent color is consistent with the sky-blue tone
Confirm the diagonal curb line provides effective depth
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key beach photography + Distressed condensed display type + Central geometric accent graphic = Coastal Urban Duo Aesthetic
